protocol.purpose: Post-release development sensitivity on fitting sources only; not independent test accuracy
protocol.group_definition: Union of origin, SAC start and centered-sample UTC dates
protocol.augmentation: Original reflected +/-8-sample shift and +/-30 degree horizontal rotation
protocol.criterion: Reciprocal training-class-frequency weighted CE; validation uses unweighted CE
protocol.epochs_scope: QSIS fitting updates only; CWA initializer has six earlier adaptation epochs and STEAD ancestry
protocol.depth_scope: 2: channels16/64 with two max pools then adaptive average pool to2; 3: exact original16/32/64; 4: add64-channel padded convolution before final max pool. Depth comparison includes its stated pooling change.
